free_tier.stated: Zed Personal: "$0 forever", "Unlimited use with your API keys or external agents like Claude Agent, Codex CLI, and more", quoted

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: the editor is free and the tokens come from whichever vendor is granting them.
limits_note: nothing binds because the vendor serves no model on this tier; the ceiling is the endpoint a user points it at.
binding_note: nothing binds because the vendor serves no model on this tier; the ceiling is the endpoint a user points it at.

identity_cost.detail: no account for the editor or for AI on the user's own API keys: the docs say signing in is not required and that AI without signing in uses the user's own keys. Sign-in, needed for Zed-hosted models and collaboration, is GitHub OAuth with the read:user scope, and the account email is the GitHub one

evidence.proved: the Personal card reads $0 forever with unlimited use on your own API keys or external agents, quoted; Pro is USD 10 a month and is the first tier with Zed-hosted models
the FAQ says the Personal plan is for users who want the editor without AI capabilities or who prefer their own keys, quoted
the editor and its AI features on the user's own keys run without an account; Zed sign-in is GitHub OAuth
evidence.quote: Signing in to Zed is not required. You can use most features you'd expect in a code editor without ever doing so.

evidence.proved: the Pro trial is 14 days with USD 5 of GPT-6 Luna usage and no card; Pro is USD 10 a month with USD 5 of token credits
evidence.quote: We offer a 14-day free trial of Pro with $5 of GPT-6 Luna usage and unlimited accepted edit predictions.

evidence.proved: the Personal plan is still $0 forever with unlimited use on the user's own keys or external agents
evidence.quote: Unlimited use with your API keys or external agents like Claude Agent, Codex CLI, and more

notes: Zed is a desktop application, so its free lane needs a machine. The vendor serves no tokens on the free Personal plan. Pro is USD 10 a month with USD 5 of token credits a month and usage beyond them at API list price +10%; a 14-day Pro trial carries USD 5 of GPT-6 Luna usage with no credit card.
